description: Smoke-control-specific default assumptions for NFPA 92 plume and vent calculations

fractionConvectiveHeatInSmokeLayer.source: NFPA 92 - default assumption for unobstructed axisymmetric plume, no significant heat loss to boundaries before entering smoke layer

convectiveFraction.source: NFPA 92 / SFPE Handbook - commonly cited range 0.6-0.8 for flaming combustion; 0.7 is the typical default

ventDischargeCoefficient.source: NFPA 204 / NFPA 92 - typical discharge coefficient for natural smoke vents; validated against Warehouse 1 project reference calculation
